subject: Request: runtime audit export + legal questions on high-error window
messages:
From: Maya R. <maya@finbridge.com>
To: support@redwood.ai, ops@finbridge.com
Cc: Legal - FinBridge <legal@finbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Severe latency + errors 08:00-08:30 PT — need logs and confirmation

Team,

We experienced a sharp spike in error rate and tail latency this morning between approx 08:00 and 08:30 PT that affected our payment verification flow (request IDs in ticket #5842). Error rate peaked at ~8% and p95 latency jumped to ~3.2s. This is causing transaction failures and customer impact.

We need:
- Export of all runtime request logs for 07:50–08:35 PT (full trace if available)
- A statement on whether any raw request payloads containing PII were logged or stored during that window
- Chain-of-custody for any artifacts you provide (who exported, transfer mechanism, checksums)

Please treat this as urgent and advise ETA. Our legal team has been looped.

Thanks,
Maya R.
Head of Platform Ops, FinBridge
[Ticket: FIN-5842]

From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@finbridge.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:22:00 -07:00

Folks — forwarding FinBridge. They want a log export and chain-of-custody. Monica, please lead the data handling and export. David, can you confirm whether the runtime captured full request bodies for that window and whether redaction was in place? Marissa, please own the customer comms and any commercial escalation.

Target: initial reply to customer within 1 hour, export availability within 4 hours.

-Sean

Cc: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Severe latency + errors 08:00-08:30 PT — need logs and confirmation

Maya — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the impact. We're on it. A few clarifying items so we can scope the export correctly: 

1) Confirm the exact time window you'd like (you asked 07:50–08:35 PT; is that correct?)
2) Do you require full request/response bodies or only metadata/traces? If full bodies are required, please confirm whether they contain PII and provide any redaction instructions.
3) Preferred delivery channel for evidence (secure SFTP, encrypted Drive share, or vendor portal)?

We're preparing an initial audit bundle. Export will include:
- Per-request metadata (ts, model, latency, status, request_id)
- KV/cache hits and routing decision logs for that period
- Runtime error traces and worker-level stderr logs (sampled)

We can provide checksums and a signed manifest for chain-of-custody. Attaching a short checklist with required fields and the SFTP upload instructions for our side.

Attachments:
- sftp-upload-instructions.txt (stub)
- evidence-request-finbridge.pdf (stub)

ETA: first bundle to you in ~3.5 hours assuming clarifications above.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Incident Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sftp-upload-instructions.txt]

From: Legal - FinBridge <legal@finbridge.com>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence & chain-of-custody for 2027-03-15 outage window

Monica / Sean,

From FinBridge Legal: we appreciate the quick response. A couple of legal/compliance asks before data transfer: 

- Please confirm whether raw request bodies containing payment tokens or customer identifiers were ever persisted to disk during the window, and if so whether they were encrypted at rest and who had access.
- For any export, provide a manifest with: exporter identity (name, employee id), export timestamp, checksum (SHA256), transfer method, and a short explanation of any transformations (redaction, truncation).
- We will require a signed acknowledgement (cookie) that exported logs will be handled under our existing DPA and will be deleted per our retention schedule unless otherwise agreed.

We are preparing a formal evidence request but wanted to land the practical details first.

Regards,
Alyssa Chen
Senior Counsel, FinBridge

From: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Legal - FinBridge <legal@finbridge.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 12:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence & chain-of-custody for 2027-03-15 outage window

Alyssa / team — technical reply below: 

Summary: the runtime does not persist full request bodies to long-term disk by default; ephemeral worker caches may hold request payloads in memory and our log pipeline scrubs payloads unless explicitly configured to persist. For the window in question:
- We observed debug-level traces for ~0.7% of requests; those traces include truncated request bodies (first 512 bytes) which may contain identifiers.
- All at-rest storage is AES-256 encrypted. Access is role-based; export processes are gated to a small export-admin group.

What we will provide:
- NDJSON export (runtime-err-20270315.ndjson) containing per-request metadata and flagged truncated bodies where available
- A signed manifest with exporter identity, timestamp, SHA256 checksum, transfer method (SFTP), and an audit hash chain for the exported bundle

Transfer plan: SFTP to FinBridge-controlled host using a one-time account and pre-shared key. We will generate checksums and PGP-sign the manifest.

Actions:
- Monica will run the export and produce the signed manifest.
- We will redact any full-card PANs and replace with tokenized patterns. We will not include raw payment tokens.

Attachments: SCP upload instructions (stub).

-David Kim
Security Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: runtime-err-20270315.ndjson (export preview, redacted)]

From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Maya R. <maya@finbridge.com>, Alyssa Chen <legal@finbridge.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 14:52:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence & chain-of-custody for 2027-03-15 outage window — plan and exec note

Maya / Alyssa — quick status update and exec-level summary for your leadership: 

What happened (brief): a transient queuing/backpressure condition during a model routing change increased retry behavior which surfaced as elevated error rates and higher p95 latency between ~08:05–08:27 PT. Impacted route: payments-verification-v2.

What we're delivering:
- Full NDJSON export (runtime-err-20270315.ndjson) with per-request metadata and redacted body snippets where applicable
- Signed manifest (SHA256), PGP-signed by our export-admin, with exporter identity and timestamps
- Transfer via SFTP to the host you designate; we will not post to public drives

Next steps:
- Monica will start the export now and target completion within 3 hours.
- David to provide the final signed manifest and checksum upon export completion.
- Marissa will prepare a short joint incident note for your execs and ours to close the loop.

We recognize this is an executive-level concern. If FinBridge wants a dedicated walkthrough of the artifacts (redaction, checksums, retention policy), we can schedule an engineering call today at 16:00 PT.

-Sean Gallagher
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: evidence-request-finbridge.pdf]
